scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/packed build && bun run --cwd packages/pi-packed build
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test packages/packed/test packages/pi-packed/service/test packages/pi-packed/test
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && bunx tsc --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/packed/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/packed/tsconfig.consumer.json && bunx tsc -p packages/pi-packed/tsconfig.json --noEmit && bunx tsc -p packages/pi-packed/service/tsconfig.consumer.json
